column1: # openapi_strict_exceptions.tsv — the SHRINK-ONLY exceptions list for the STRICT
# FuzzOpenAPIStateful gate (oracle 1: no undeclared 5xx). One row per (operation,
# status) that strict mode would otherwise fail on, each a REAL still-unfixed
# undeclared-5xx defect held so the nightly strict gate stays green while the fix
# is pending.
# Enforced by TestOpenAPIStrictExceptions (server/http/openapi_strict_exceptions_test.go):
#   - CAN ONLY SHRINK: every row's deterministic reproducer must still return the
#     listed undeclared 5xx against the real router. A row whose defect was fixed
#     (no longer 5xx) FAILS the test, forcing its removal.
#   - CANNOT GROW SILENTLY: the (operation,status) set here must EXACTLY equal the
#     waiver set the fuzzer consults (osKnownUndeclared5xx). A new undeclared 5xx
#     cannot be waived in the fuzzer without a row here (with issue + owner), and
#     no row can exist without a matching fuzzer waiver. Combined with strict mode
#     being FATAL on any undeclared 5xx not in osKnownUndeclared5xx, the list is
#     append-blocked: a new class fails the nightly gate until triaged into BOTH.
# Columns (tab-separated): operation  status  verdict  issue  owner  reason
#   verdict ∈ {mapped-wrongly, missing-sentinel, genuinely-internal}
#   issue   = "#NNNN" if repo docs/code name one, else "NEEDS ISSUE"
